name: Tim Moore
subject: Can I count on you today?
disclaimer_text: paid for by Friends of Tim Moore
body:
Peter, today's the day, and before anything else, I want to say _THANK YOU._ Every door you knocked, every call you made, every dollar you gave got us here. Serving the people of this district has been the honor of my life, and I don't take a single vote for granted.So I'm humbly asking: **if you haven 't voted yet, will you go today?** [](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhddddk-hkhielhuy-r/) **Polls are open until 7:30 PM tonight. Find your polling place at[https://vt.ncsbe.gov/PPLkup/](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhddddk-hkhielhuy-y/) and bring your photo ID. And if you're in line at 7:30, stay in line!** Still have a mail ballot? Drop it off at your county board of elections by 7:30 PM. Polling places can't accept it. [FIND MY POLLING PLACE ->](https://timmoore.cmail19.com/t/y-l-fhddddk-hkhielhuy-j/) Democrats came into today outvoting us, and the stakes couldn't be higher. My opponent is facing a FELONY charge and refuses to denounce socialism. _Our taxes, our border, and our families ' future all hang on keeping the House._This election is too important to sit out. But I believe with all my heart that America's best days are still ahead of her, and today we get to prove it.**Please vote, and bring someone with you.** Thank you, Congressman Tim Moore
